pages.title: Running In Foam
pages.creator: XMetaGame
pages.description: Race through a world of colorful foam in Running In Foam. Change lanes to avoid barriers, jump over obstacles, and slide beneath others as the track continues. Gather gems along the way to unlock characters and power-ups for later runs.

pages.title: Smart Dots Reloaded
pages.creator: Cassino.dev
pages.description: Complete more squares than your opponent in Smart Dots Reloaded. Take turns adding lines between neighboring dots, scoring a point whenever you close a box. Play against the computer or another player and compare totals when every space is filled.

pages.title: Neighborhood Defense
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Stop zombie waves from overrunning the neighborhood in Neighborhood Defense. Place archers, bombers, snipers, and electric turrets in the available building spots, then upgrade their damage and reach. Watch the different exits and combine defenses so enemies cannot slip through an unprotected route.

pages.title: Isometric Escape 2
pages.creator: isotronic
pages.description: Search compact rooms for a way out in Isometric Escape 2. Click objects to examine them, find hidden items, and solve the riddles linking the clues together. Use details from the isometric scenes to work out what unlocks the escape.

pages.title: Brainrot Boing Boing Merge
pages.creator: Iamgronig
pages.description: Drop creatures into the play area in Brainrot Boing Boing Merge. Bring matching characters together to create new ones and build your score. Account for the pieces' bouncing physics as you choose where the next creature should fall.

pages.title: Sandbox Island War
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Develop islands and prepare for conquest in Sandbox Island War. Place humans to establish growing towns, add sheep for food and wool, and gather resources for your settlements. Build bases and strengthen your island holdings before expanding into another battle.

pages.title: Zombie Terminator
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Fight through a zombie outbreak in Zombie Terminator. View the action through the survivor's eyes and use the available weapons to hunt the undead. Keep track of approaching enemies as you try to remain alive in the ruined world.

pages.title: Turbo Stars
pages.creator: SayGames Ltd
pages.description: Race a skateboard through rival-filled tracks in Turbo Stars. Grab useful items, collect coins and keys, and throw nearby competitors out of your way. Unlock different rides, equipment, and power-ups as you work toward beating the other racers.

pages.title: Obby Massive Attack
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help rescue city residents in Obby Massive Attack. Guide Obby and friends through an endless run, gathering coins and bonuses along the route. Superpower pickups let you clear threats ahead, while the shop offers further powers and characters to unlock.

pages.title: Kitty Couple Lovely Valentine
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare Angela and Tom for their date in Kitty Couple Lovely Valentine. Choose outfits for the cats, search for hidden hearts, and assemble their couple photo. Complete the different activities to finish their Valentine's Day preparations.

pages.title: Sorting Balls
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Organize colored balls into tubes in Sorting Balls. Move a tube's top ball onto a matching color or into an empty tube. Plan where to keep spare balls as you separate the mixed stacks and group every color together.

pages.title: Siberian Assault
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Survive enemy assaults in a frozen wilderness in Siberian Assault. Aim and fire from a first-person view while hostile forces arrive in waves. Pick up equipment, use the scope for aimed shots, and switch weapons to handle the fighting.

pages.title: CarJamcolor
pages.creator: Funnyplus
pages.description: Free cars in the right order in CarJamcolor. A crowded parking lot blocks the vehicles needed to collect waiting passengers. Work out which car has room to leave, then use the space it opens to get the remaining transport moving.

pages.title: Robots Gone Wild
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: Outlast malfunctioning machines in Robots Gone Wild. Steer around attacking robots while your weapon automatically targets the nearest enemy. Collect blue dots, improve armor and guns, and keep building the survivor's strength as the waves become harder.

pages.title: Duck Hunting Open Season
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Earn shots by matching items in Duck Hunting Open Season. Clear groups of at least three identical pieces to collect bullets for the duck hunt. Explosives, rockets, and hammers can remove more of the board and help you meet each level's objective.

pages.title: Avatar Master - Fix Up Face
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Repair distorted portraits in Avatar Master - Fix Up Face. Drag the points on each picture until the character's features return to their correct positions. Work through faces ranging from anime characters to Vikings and knights, using the image as your guide.

pages.title: Merge Sesame
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Drop matching fruit into a container in Merge Sesame. Bring identical pieces together to create a different fruit and add to your score. Choose the drop position to set up consecutive combinations and keep useful matches accessible.

pages.title: Draw to Fish Fight
pages.creator: Visual Dream Games
pages.description: Draw your way into fish fights in Draw to Fish Fight. Use the mouse to direct Skibidi's attack, hit the fish, and collect points. Avoid obstacles along the route and gather bonuses that strengthen the character for the next encounter.

pages.title: Romantic Match Tactics
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Arrange romantic tokens in Romantic Match Tactics. Move items into trios while conserving the available moves, and match magical keys to release locked pieces. Work around blocked spaces across forty-eight levels to clear the grid's required combinations.

pages.title: Extreme Buggy Truck Driving 3D
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Drive a buggy through racing courses in Extreme Buggy Truck Driving 3D. Steer past obstacles and other drivers while working toward the finish. Use WASD to move and the space bar for the game's firing action.

pages.title: Mahjong Holiday
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Travel between destinations by clearing tiles in Mahjong Holiday. Select matching pairs that are uncovered and open at the sides, removing the layout as quickly as possible. Visit a hundred holiday scenes and aim for three stars on each board.

pages.title: Wizard Arcadia
pages.creator: Dev Hub Games
pages.description: Defend a magical kingdom in Wizard Arcadia. Connect matching symbols on the spell panel to create magic, then use those spells against the invading villains. Choose combinations that help the wizard protect his home from enemies seeking its magical energy.

pages.title: Violet Fall Fashion Shoot
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style a superhero for an autumn photo session in Violet Fall Fashion Shoot. Explore the available fashion choices and put together a seasonal look for Violet. Prepare her for the pictures she plans to share on social media.

pages.title: Super Snappy Hoops
pages.creator: Gamebop
pages.description: Shoot baskets with swipes in Super Snappy Hoops. Set up each throw by dragging toward the hoop and judge the direction needed to sink the ball. Keep improving your shooting as you work toward a higher place in the competition.

pages.title: Super Kick 3D World Cup
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Find a way past the goalkeeper in Super Kick 3D World Cup. Move on your own playing field and line up the kick needed to send the ball into the goal. Concentrate on the shot rather than competing with teammates for possession.

pages.title: Solitaire Swift
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build ascending card stacks in Solitaire Swift. Select a card and its destination, placing it on a stack whose top card is one rank lower. Arrange the deck from aces toward kings and move every card into its required stack to finish.

pages.title: Impostors vs Zombies: Survival
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Rescue crewmates while fighting an outbreak in Impostors vs Zombies: Survival. Search the space station, defeat infected enemies, and gather the money they drop. Buy rockets and improve your weapons to keep the growing group alive against further attacks.

pages.title: Undine Match the Pic
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Find altered details in Undine Match the Pic. Compare pairs of mermaid and sea-creature pictures and select their differences before the timer expires. Retry a scene if the clock runs out before you locate every change.

pages.title: Pool Shooter Billiard Ball
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fire colored billiard balls in Pool Shooter Billiard Ball. Aim into the existing formation to gather matching groups and clear them. Choose where each shot lands so the remaining colors still have a useful place to go.

pages.title: Food Pusher Challenge
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Feed a wrestler to strengthen your team in Food Pusher Challenge. Collect food around the arena and bring it to your partner during the two-team contest. Favor the high-calorie items and avoid green foods as you help your wrestler overpower the opposition.

pages.title: Jump Impostor Up
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Climb out of a canyon in Jump Impostor Up. Time jumps between its walls to carry the trapped character toward safety. Collect coins and bonuses on the climb to improve abilities and help with the next stretch.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Leon Run
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Dodge hazards in Brawl Stars Leon Run. Jump over obstacles and dangerous enemies while gathering coins along the course. Unlock more avatars and replay the stages to improve your score and extend the run.

pages.title: Siege Hero Pirate Pillage
pages.creator: Blaster
pages.description: Bring down pirate structures in Siege Hero Pirate Pillage. Aim stones and other ammunition at supports that can collapse ships with few shots. Protect innocent characters while removing pirates and uncovering the gold hidden among the wreckage.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja 6
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Reach the chest in Kingdom of Ninja 6. Move through a dark dungeon, jump over obstacles, and keep clear of lava, monsters, and bladed wheels. Use Z to jump and the arrow keys to guide the ninja through each level.

pages.title: Fish Gone
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Catch as many fish as possible in Fish Gone. Use mouse or touch controls to work the fishing action and watch for the troublesome fish that interferes with your catches. Keep gathering fish while dealing with that extra obstacle.

pages.title: Xmas Bubble Army
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear festive clusters in Xmas Bubble Army. Aim a ball to make a group of at least three matching colors before any ball reaches the lower boundary. Earn coins for power-ups and continue from the game's automatically saved progress.

pages.title: Halloween Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reach each board's target in Halloween Match 3 Deluxe. Match at least three identical seasonal items and use hourglasses, bombs, or the jolly item when they can help. Adapt your combinations as the levels become more difficult.

pages.title: Super Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pop matching clusters in Super Bubble Shooter. Fire at groups of three or more of one color while navigating rock bubbles, glass bubbles, and spikes. Plan the next shot around these obstacles and work toward more stars on each level.

pages.title: Boat Challenge
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Gather coins on the water in Boat Challenge. Guide the boat around obstacles and keep collecting as the course continues. Judge the next opening before steering toward another coin to improve your total.

pages.title: Swing Monkey
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swing between anchor points in Swing Monkey. Tap to attach the rope to a nearby point, then release to send the monkey forward. Judge the arc and catch another anchor to continue across successive courses.

pages.title: Amazing Word Twist
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Build words from six letters in Amazing Word Twist. Rearrange the supplied set to find as many valid answers as possible. Change the in-game language to try the same word-making challenge with another vocabulary.

pages.title: Little Ballerinas Coloring
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Color dance-themed drawings in Little Ballerinas Coloring. Choose shades for the ballerinas and fill the picture using the available crayons. Use a mouse click or touch to apply colors and create your own version of the scene.

pages.title: Water Flow
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Guide water through a pipe arrangement in Water Flow. Pull or drag pins to change which routes are open. Inspect the connections before releasing the flow so it follows the path you need.

pages.title: ATV Quad Bike Impossible Stunt
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Ride mountain trails on a quad in ATV Quad Bike Impossible Stunt. Guide the four-wheeler across dusty off-road terrain and control its direction through the route. Use WASD or the arrow keys to handle the vehicle.

pages.title: Lowpolly Car Racing Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Race across icy off-road tracks in Lowpolly Car Racing Game. Compete for the leading position while keeping the car on the course. Use the mouse control to guide your drive against the other racers.

pages.title: Snoring Elephant Puzzle
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Wake a sleeping giant in Snoring Elephant Puzzle. Use the other animals and objects in each scene to disturb the elephant's rest. Work out which interactions move the pieces into position and complete the animal puzzle.

pages.title: Stack Ball Fun
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Descend a rotating tower in Stack Ball Fun. Click to drive the ball through the platforms while avoiding the black tiles. Watch the sections beneath the ball and wait for a suitable opening before continuing downward.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Free Gems Spin Wheel
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Try a gem-themed spinner in Brawl Stars Free Gems Spin Wheel. Click the button to start the wheel and watch where it stops. The activity centers on spinning and viewing the result shown by the game.

pages.title: MineBlock Earth Survival
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Keep running beneath falling meteors in MineBlock Earth Survival. Avoid impacts for as long as you can, and look for the mushroom pickup. Collecting it clears the meteors currently on the screen and gives you room to continue.

pages.title: 2 Player Head Basketball
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Outscore a rival in 2 Player Head Basketball. Choose a solo or two-player match and adjust the court, ball, characters, and playing time. Use bonuses to grow, move faster, or freeze your opponent while trying to finish with the higher total.

pages.title: Chained Tractor Towing Train Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Pull a heavy load with farm machinery in Chained Tractor Towing Train Game. Steer the tractor and its attached vehicle toward the destination across uneven ground. Finish the transport task within the level's time limit while keeping the tow moving.

pages.title: Advance Car Parking Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Practice precision driving in Advance Car Parking Game. Take different vintage cars through parking missions and guide each one into its required space. Concentrate on positioning and controlled movement as the parking layouts become more demanding.

pages.title: Asteroids Wave
pages.creator: Mabno
pages.description: Save three threatened planets in Asteroids Wave. Control a UFO and destroy the incoming asteroids before they overwhelm the worlds below. Keep track of fuel and collect gems while maintaining the defense.

pages.title: Crazy Monster Truck Water Slide Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Take a large vehicle onto floating routes in Crazy Monster Truck Water Slide Game. Drive over water-themed tracks and perform stunts around the beach setting. Use the different camera views to judge the route through each driving challenge.

pages.title: Petits chevaux : small horses
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Race your horses home in Petits chevaux : small horses. Roll the die and move your pawns around the board toward the central finishing area. Play with up to four participants, choosing computer opponents or friends for the contest.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Vanilla
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Aim and fire bubbles in Bubble Shooter Vanilla. Use the left mouse button to send shots into the field and clear matching colors. Work through the levels and use the available power-ups to help with difficult arrangements.

pages.title: Jungle Temple Blast
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Explore a hidden temple through match-three boards in Jungle Temple Blast. Combine matching gems to clear the puzzle objectives and continue the treasure hunt. Work through hundreds of arrangements as you uncover the structure's riches.

pages.title: Wall Jump
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Climb between two surfaces in Wall Jump. Use the mouse to time leaps from one wall to the other and carry the character higher. Keep the ascent going to improve your best score.

pages.title: Football.io
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Defend your goal against three rivals in Football.io. Use the mouse or arrow keys to position your player and keep the ball out while trying to eliminate opponents. Remain in the contest until the other players are out to win.

pages.title: Halloween Runner
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Guide a witch home in Halloween Runner. Collect pumpkins while jumping over hazards or ducking beneath them. Keep clear of bats, gravestones, and spiders that can bring the journey to an end.

pages.title: BTS Halloween Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a seasonal drawing in BTS Halloween Coloring Book. Apply colors to the characters and decorations with mouse or touch controls. Work through the details to create your own Halloween picture.

pages.title: Candy Monsters
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fly through a field of sweets in Candy Monsters. Collect coins for points while keeping away from the doughnuts and candies themselves. Steer through the openings for as long as possible in the endless run.

pages.title: Happy Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Help a yellow bird clear the field in Happy Bubble Shooter. Aim shots to create groups of at least three bubbles of the same color. Remove every bubble to complete the board, choosing the next landing spot carefully.

pages.title: Crossbar Challenge
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Aim for the frame of the goal in Crossbar Challenge. Swipe to kick the ball and try to strike the crossbar itself. With no goalkeeper to beat, the challenge is the precision needed to hit that narrow target.

pages.title: Gonna Fly
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Keep an unlikely flyer airborne in Gonna Fly. Tap to gain height and avoid obstacles, or drag downward to slide beneath a barrier. Guide characters such as a penguin, kiwi, or fish through the route as they compete to become champion.

pages.title: Kart Race 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Race along obstacle-filled tracks in Kart Race 3D. Steer left and right to keep your vehicle on course and confront opponents ahead. Use its attacking capabilities to clear threats while working toward a winning finish.

pages.title: EG Space Purge
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Protect Earth from incoming rocks in EG Space Purge. Move the ship while firing at asteroids and small planets, and collect additional ammunition and points. Ship choices, lasers, protection, and life improvements provide different ways to strengthen the defense.

pages.title: EG Traffic Command
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Manage a busy intersection in EG Traffic Command. Change the traffic signals to decide which cars wait and which proceed. Coordinate the streams of vehicles so they can move through the streets without conflicting with one another.

pages.title: Forest Match 3
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Make groups of three matching pieces in Forest Match 3. Use the mouse to arrange matches and clear the requirements of each board. Progress through the levels and turn to power-ups when the remaining pieces are difficult to combine.

pages.title: High Hoops
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a bouncing ball through rings in High Hoops. Use the mouse to adjust its movement and line up with each hoop. Keep the ball's path centered on the openings to continue scoring through the course.

pages.title: Pyramid Diamonds Challenge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Blast matching gems in Pyramid Diamonds Challenge. Select groups of at least three diamonds and link quick explosions to activate fury mode. Use magical powers while chasing higher scores across two modes, taking care to avoid smaller groups.

pages.title: EG Baby Girl
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Create an outfit in EG Baby Girl. Mix tops, skirts or other bottoms, dresses, shoes, and hairstyles, then add hats and jewelry. Try the available pieces together to give the character a complete coordinated look.

pages.title: Ariel Missing Eric
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Help lift Ariel's spirits in Ariel Missing Eric. Join Rapunzel and Cinderella as they plan shopping, new outfits, and a night of dancing while Eric studies abroad. Choose looks for the friends as they prepare their outing.

pages.title: Logicheck
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Match one outline to another in Logicheck. Drag the shape's vertices until it lines up with the reference image. Compare the corners and edges after each adjustment to work out the remaining movements.

pages.title: Bloxorz Roll the Block
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Roll a rectangular block across platforms in Bloxorz Roll the Block. Work out which moves lead to the destination without losing the block over an edge. Consider how its orientation changes the space needed for the next step.

pages.title: Galactic Force
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a combat class in Galactic Force. Fight as a health-regenerating Fighter, a shield-bearing Tank, or a Scout with a slide ability. Use the advantages of your chosen hero while moving and shooting through the science-fiction battles.

pages.title: Princess Pride Day
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare four friends for a parade in Princess Pride Day. Choose colorful clothing and accessories for Rapunzel, Elsa, Moana, and Ariel. Mix the available pieces into individual celebration outfits before they join the street event.

pages.title: Flow Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Fill a grid with connected paths in Flow Mania. Link each pair of matching dots and cover every space without crossing or overlapping another pipe. Solve three sets of twenty-five puzzles by planning how the colors share the board.

pages.title: Super Basketball
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Score baskets against the clock in Super Basketball. Sink shots to increase your total and add five seconds to the remaining time with every success. Keep making baskets to extend the attempt and push your score higher.

pages.title: Cyber Basket
pages.creator: Solstice Games
pages.description: Send a ball through openings in Cyber Basket. Hit panels and guide the ball into the holes to add points. Judge the route before each attempt and keep working toward a higher total.

pages.title: Wheely 5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a small car escape a meteor disaster in Wheely 5. Click objects in each scene to operate mechanisms, solve puzzles, and open a route forward. Search for useful items as you guide Wheely away from the danger.

pages.title: Homemade Ice Cream Cooking
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Make a frozen dessert in Homemade Ice Cream Cooking. Follow the kitchen instructions to prepare the ice cream, then choose its presentation. Combine the cooking steps with decorative details to finish your own dessert design.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Die 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Save accident-prone creatures in Silly Ways To Die 2. Read each short situation and react with the mouse before the danger catches them. Keep responding to the different hazards to prevent another mishap.

pages.title: General Rockets
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Keep a character bouncing across flying missiles in General Rockets. Use the mouse to control the action as rockets move through the sky. Judge each bounce to continue the journey across the moving supports.

pages.title: Brave Bull
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Reunite a bull with his girlfriend in Brave Bull. Activate springs and other mechanisms to move him through the scene's obstacles. Consider the order of the interactions so the physics carry him to the rescue.

pages.title: Ladybug Wedding Royal Guests
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dress a superhero couple in Ladybug Wedding Royal Guests. Choose Ladybug's gown, hair, accessories, and bouquet before preparing Cat Noir's wedding suit. Continue styling the invited guests to complete the celebration's looks.

pages.title: Princesses Bridal Salon
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Create a wedding outfit in Princesses Bridal Salon. Select a princess and choose her gown, hairstyle, and jewelry. Add a veil and bouquet to bring all the bridal details together.

pages.title: Princesses On Vogue Cover
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare fashion models for a magazine appearance in Princesses On Vogue Cover. Browse their clothing and choose outfits for the event following their cover feature. Coordinate the pieces to complete each model's look.
